# Rye & Rise message sheet

## One-liner

Most people only get proper bread at weekends. Rye & Rise opens at 6:30 with tonight's sourdough on a shelf with your name on it, so every weekday starts with a real breakfast.

| Problem | Solution | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Most people only get proper bread at weekends. | Rye & Rise opens at 6:30 with tonight's sourdough on a shelf with your name on it, | so every weekday starts with a real breakfast. |

## Positioning

| | |
|---|---|
| Who it's for | Busy neighbours on the north side who want real bread but can't get to a bakery before work. |
| In one sentence | A neighbourhood sourdough bakery that opens at 6:30 so good bread fits a working morning. |
| In one paragraph | Rye & Rise bakes slow-fermented sourdough, rye and seasonal buns every night and opens at 6:30 on weekdays. Pre-order by 9 pm and your loaf waits on a named shelf, so the walk to work includes breakfast. |
| Category | Neighbourhood bakery |
| Different from | Supermarket bread (fast, soft, forgettable) and weekend-only artisan bakeries. |

## Copy limits by format

Words allowed per part (0 = leave it out).

| Format | Headline | Subhead | Body | CTA | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Billboard / large outdoor | 7 | 0 | 0 | 4 | One idea, one image. CTA is a short URL or handle. |
| Poster (A3, A2, 18x24 in) | 10 | 18 | 40 | 6 | Readable from 3 m. Details (date, place, URL) go in small type. |
| Event poster | 8 | 15 | 30 | 6 | Details must include date, time and place. |
| Instagram / LinkedIn post (on-image text) | 8 | 12 | 25 | 5 | The caption is separate; its first line (about 125 characters) shows before 'more'. |
| Instagram / Facebook story, Reel cover | 8 | 10 | 15 | 4 | Keep text out of the top and bottom 250 px (interface overlays). |
| Carousel slide | 10 | 15 | 40 | 5 | First slide is the hook; last slide carries the CTA. |
| YouTube thumbnail | 5 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Three to five big words, maximum. |
| Display banner | 6 | 8 | 0 | 3 | CTA as a button. |
| Website hero section | 10 | 25 | 50 | 4 | Headline: what you offer. Subhead: how life gets better. Button: the next step. |
| Email header and subject | 9 | 15 | 80 | 4 | Subject line under about 50 characters. |
| Flyer (A5, A4) | 12 | 20 | 150 | 8 | Use subheads to break body copy. |
| Long-copy print ad | 16 | 25 | 600 | 10 | Image, headline, body, then logo and CTA. Caption every image. |
